en: Black-and-white image of a mid‑20th‑century cargo or tanker ship sailing near a coastline. The vessel has a dark hull and white superstructure, with signal flags strung from a mast and smoke faintly visible from the funnel. Low hills and scattered coastal buildings appear hazily in the background across calm water. The ship's name, painted on the bow, reads "JONQUIERES."
